d: Delhi’s Yamuna is once again covered in thick, white froth, raising fresh questions about the health of one of the capital’s most important rivers. But what is causing this recurring phenomenon, and why has the pollution crisis proved so difficult to tackle? As the city explores plans to transform its riverfront, a bigger question emerges: can the Yamuna be revived, or will its environmental challenges continue to overshadow its future? Watch this video as Firstpost explains what lies behind the river’s worsening condition and what it will take to turn the tide. Gursshheen Gahllen brings…
